questions.q: What did Daniel refuse to eat and drink in Babylon?
options: The king's rich food and wine
questions.evidence: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s dainties, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself

questions.q: For how many days did Daniel ask to be tested on vegetables and water?
questions.evidence: Test your servants, I beg you, ten days

questions.q: How many men did the king see walking in the middle of the fire?
questions.evidence: He answered, Look, I see four men loose, walking in the middle of the fire, and they are unharmed

questions.q: What words were written on the wall at Belshazzar's feast?
questions.evidence: This is the writing that was inscribed: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN

questions.q: Into what was Daniel cast at King Darius' command?
questions.evidence: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions

questions.q: How did Daniel prove the two elders lied about Susanna?
questions.evidence: Then said Daniel to them, Put them asunder one far from another, and I will examine them

questions.q: What did Daniel have scattered over the floor of Bel's temple?
questions.evidence: Now Daniel had commanded his servants to bring ashes, and they strewed all the temple with them in the presence of the king alone
